data.name: Mihri
data.gender_notes: Mihri is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Mihri means 'seeker of water'. This name holds a special significance in Islamic tradition as it is mentioned in the Quran when Prophet Moses (PBUH) asks God for guidance during his journey in the desert. God responds by sending a cloud and a river to quench Moses' thirst, symbolizing the divine Provision and Sustenance. This name thus embodies the spiritual quest for sustenance and guidance from the Divine.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mihri total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
